tools.name: transcript
tools.description: Read a messages.jsonl transcript as text, your own by default, or another profile's (path profile:<category>/<name>), a sub-agent run's (path subagent:<run id>) or a file (path path:<file>): user and assistant messages, tool calls and their results, by turn. Reasoning is not shown. Use turns or tail to choose which turns, role, tool and search to filter, source backup for the history before the last compaction, cursor to continue a cut response.

path.description: Which transcript to read; omit it for your own (a sub-agent reads its own run). profile:<category>/<name> is another profile in this session and profile:<session>/<category>/<name> one in another session; subagent:<run id> (sub_xxxxxxxx) is a run of your profile, subagent:<category>/<name>/<run id> a run of another profile in this session and subagent:<session>/<category>/<name>/<run id> one of another session; path:<file> is a transcript file by filesystem path (off unless tools.native.transcript.allow_path is true). The header of a read and a not-found error give the exact path to reuse.

turns.description: Which turns to read: 3, 3-7, -5 (the last five) or 12- (from turn 12). A turn is a user message and the answer to it. Without turns, tail or cursor, the last turn is read.

tail.description: Read the last N turns; the same as turns -N. Not with turns or cursor.

source.description: messages (default) is the live transcript; backup is messages.backup.jsonl, the history before the last compaction.

role.description: Only entries of this role; tool is a tool call and its result.

tool.description: Only calls and results of tools whose name matches; * and ? are wildcards (read, exec*).

search.description: Only entries whose text contains this, case-insensitive, with context entries around each.

context.description: With search: how many entries to show on each side of a match. Default 0.

full.description: Do not cut the text of one entry (the whole response is still capped).

cursor.description: Continue where the previous response stopped; use the cursor it gave. Not with turns or tail.
